selection_rule.scene_rule: Take every scene in upstream project_lists/validation_list.txt in its published order, then append the first scenes from project_lists/BlendedMVS.txt that are not already in validation_list until 10 total scenes are reached.
selection_rule.view_rule: Within each scene, parse cams/pair.txt; use the first reference record as the single world-generation input and retain every source view listed in that record as held-out candidate imagery. Never select views based on model output quality.
selection_rule.pose_rule: Use each *_cam.txt calibration to compute actual camera pose separation. Do not label arbitrary held-out views as pure yaw/pitch perturbations. Metric translation is reported only if scene scale is independently established.

notes: This scene set was frozen before running Marble or any competing world generator.
The first three non-validation scenes are appended only because the official validation list contains seven scenes.
The bootstrap is for pipeline debugging and initial falsification, not a final statistically representative benchmark split.
